steps.caption: Gabe, the AI helper
steps.narration: Gabe is ConstructHUB's AI helper. He explains how each feature works and how to set it up.

steps.caption: Open Gabe
steps.narration: Open him from the gator in the bottom corner.

steps.caption: Your questions and today's attempts
steps.narration: The top shows your plan's questions, and today's attempts so far.

steps.caption: Quick questions
steps.narration: Quick questions cover the common ones, like getting started or the CRM. They're never counted.

steps.value: How do I get more Google reviews?
steps.caption: Type your own question
steps.narration: Signed in, you can also type your own question, up to 500 characters.

steps.caption: Send
steps.narration: Each one uses a question from your plan's monthly allowance.

steps.caption: He can't see your account
steps.narration: He can't see your account, and emails or phone numbers you type are blanked out before he reads them.

steps.caption: A short answer
steps.narration: He answers in a few short lines, from ConstructHUB's own knowledge pack.

steps.value: Where do I find my Google review link?
steps.caption: Ask a follow-up
steps.narration: Ask a follow-up. He keeps the last few turns of the chat in mind.

steps.caption: Links only to ConstructHUB pages
steps.narration: His answers stay short, and his links only go to ConstructHUB pages, where you do the step.

steps.caption: Start a new chat
steps.narration: The chat lives only in this tab. Start a new one here any time.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: Close the panel when you're done.

steps.caption: Gabe, bottom right
steps.narration: You'll find Gabe in the bottom corner of your dashboard.

youtube.title: Gabe, the AI helper, in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A short tour of Gabe, ConstructHUB's AI helper: the quick questions anyone can tap, typing your own question when signed in, a follow-up, and what he can and can't see. He answers from ConstructHUB's own knowledge pack and links only to ConstructHUB pages.
